title: The Little Bear Who Brushed Like a Champion: Clean Teeth!

lines.text: Barnaby the little bear loved eating sweet berries, crunchy honey-toast, and dried apples!
lines.caps: Barnaby the little bear loved eating sweet berries, crunchy honey-toast, and dried *APPLES!

lines.text: When bedtime arrived, Barnaby crawled under his quilt without visiting the bathroom sink!
lines.caps: When bedtime arrived, Barnaby crawled under his quilt without visiting the bathroom *SINK!

lines.text: Skipping brushing leaves tiny sugary crumbs wedged between teeth where germs party!
lines.caps: Skipping brushing leaves tiny sugary crumbs wedged between teeth where germs *PARTY!

lines.text: In his dream, tiny Sugar Bugs with little pickaxes began drilling holes in white enamel shields!
lines.caps: In his dream, tiny Sugar Bugs with little pickaxes began drilling holes in white *ENAMEL | *SHIELDS!

lines.text: Barnaby woke up with a start, jumped out of bed, and reached for his superhero toothbrush!
lines.caps: Barnaby woke up with a start, jumped out of bed, and reached for his superhero *TOOTHBRUSH!

lines.text: Brush top teeth! Brush bottom teeth! Brush the chewing surfaces for two full minutes!
lines.caps: Brush top teeth! Brush bottom teeth! Brush the chewing surfaces for two full *MINUTES!

lines.text: Frothy minty bubbles scrubbed every single sugar bug down the shiny drain pipe!
lines.caps: Frothy minty bubbles scrubbed every single sugar bug down the shiny drain *PIPE!

lines.text: Brushing morning and night keeps your smile sparkling bright, fresh, and cavity-free!
lines.caps: Brushing morning and night keeps your smile sparkling bright, fresh, and *CAVITY-FREE!

lines.text: Brush like a champion and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
